experiences.position: Senior Practice Director - Corporate and Intellectual Property
experiences.description:
Sandra Milloy is the senior practice director for Gowling WLG’s Corporate and Intellectual Property departments, supporting the business, financial and operational management of a range of national practice groups within these areas.

Prior to her current role, Sandra served as general manager of the firm’s Ottawa office for more than 20 years and was a member of the Ottawa Office Management Committee. In that role, she oversaw all non-legal services within the Ottawa office and was responsible for the business management of office operations, including personnel, accounting, marketing, office services, facilities and systems.

Sandra has been with the firm since 1992 and previously served as the firm’s national director of information technology.
